title: High-Nuclearity Ln210Al140 Clusters: Neonates of Open Hollow Dodecahedral Cage Families

synthesis.procedure: A suspension of Al(OH)(OAc)2, Dy(ClO4)3, and NaClO4 in acetonitrile was reacted solvothermally at 80 °C. The article directs readers to the Supporting Information for preparation details; no reagent quantity is given in the main text.

reagents.name: dysprosium perchlorate
reagents.amount: 2 mmol, supplied as a 1 M solution

reagents.name: sodium hydroxide
reagents.amount: 1 M aqueous solution; volume not reported

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: The reaction mixture was filtered into a beaker. Ambient evaporation of the filtrate produced block-shaped colorless crystals after about one week.

source_locations.location: Supporting Information, synthesis of compound 1, paragraph following its formula

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A discrete, open hollow cage assembled from 20 Dy3Al7 decanuclear triangular-pyramid units and 30 Dy5 pentanuclear tetragonal-pyramid units. Its 350-metal skeleton has four nested shells, from outside inward: a Dy30 icosidodecahedron, an Al20 dodecahedron, a Dy180 quasi-dodecahedron, and an Al120 truncated icosidodecahedron. The cationic cage is approximately 5.0 nm across, with an approximately 2.8 nm inner cavity and 0.66 nm windows.

synthesis.procedure: The article states that compound 2 was synthesized by replacing Dy3+ with Y3+; its detailed preparation is not provided in the main text.

reagents.name: yttrium perchlorate
reagents.amount: 2 mmol, substituted for the 1 M dysprosium perchlorate solution in the procedure for 1

reagents.name: sodium hydroxide
reagents.amount: 1 M aqueous solution; volume not reported

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Following the procedure for 1, the mixture was filtered and the filtrate evaporated under ambient conditions. Block-shaped colorless crystals of 2 were obtained after about one week.

source_locations.location: Abstract, opening results paragraph, and conclusion
Supporting Information, synthesis of compound 2, paragraph following its formula; shared procedure in the preceding synthesis of compound 1

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The Y analogue of 1 is reported as an open hollow, 350-metal cage with a Keplerate-type four-shell architecture: truncated icosidodecahedron@dodecahedron@dodecahedron@icosidodecahedron. The article describes this architecture for both 1 and 2 but gives the detailed building-unit analysis for 1.
